summary: 6 film announcements, 5 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Deep End
film.talent: Shawn Levy (21 Laps), Alex Cooper (Unwell Productions)
film.announcement: Netflix has acquired the film rights to Ali Hazelwood's adult romance novel with Shawn Levy's 21 Laps and Alex Cooper's Unwell Productions producing the feature adaptation.

film.title: Doctor Caligari's Cabinet of Wonders
film.announcement: Talia Ryder has joined Michael Shannon in the film Doctor Caligari's Cabinet of Wonders.

film.title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
film.talent: Tim Blake Nelson (director), Amanda Seyfried, Scoot McNairy
film.announcement: Tim Blake Nelson's The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd, starring Amanda Seyfried and Scoot McNairy, has boarded WestEnd Films for international sales.

film.title: Aman
film.announcement: The trans pregnancy drama Aman has boarded Nikkhil Advani and Dominique Welinski as executive producers ahead of its Toronto World Premiere.

film.title: The Bridge
film.announcement: The October 7 survivors documentary The Bridge, produced by Kevin Bright, has set a North American release date.

film.title: Bound By Duty
film.announcement: ReelShort has adapted Cora Reilly's Bound By Duty as its latest mafia romance microdrama.

tv.title: Trauma
tv.announcement: Richard Madden will star in the medical hostage thriller series Trauma at Paramount+ (with Prime Video UK also involved).
HBO has boarded the BBC drama series 1536, based on Ava Pickett's West End play.

tv.title: Mrs. Saturday Night
tv.announcement: Comedian Tammy Pescatelli has partnered with Comedy Dynamics on the new special Mrs. Saturday Night.

tv.title: The Varnell Hill Show
tv.announcement: The Martin spinoff The Varnell Hill Show has set a September release date and dropped first look photos.

tv.title: Carnival of the Animals
tv.announcement: PBS Kids has partnered with conductor Gustavo Dudamel on the 2D animated special Carnival of the Animals.
